correctness.rationale: For each m, the exact radial model is weighted polynomials of degree d=L-m. The k-fold exterior restriction map has unique lowest coefficient-index wedge 0,...,k-1, giving the leading product determinant det(H_k)det(G_k) and exponent k(m+k). Neighbor ratios yield lambda_mj exponent m+2j+1. Shifted Jacobi monic norms and endpoint kernels give the closed positive constants; triangular multiplicities and extremal condition number then follow. The packaged verify.py passed 291 independent exact-rational assertions for all modes through L=8; finite checks only corroborate the general analytical argument.

value.rationale: A natural complete inverse-problem spectrum has L-dependent loss of observability across 2L+1 sharp powers, a triangular multiplicity law, and an explicit unique least-visible zonal direction with exact condition-number coefficient. This is stronger than a trace/Shannon estimate and mathematically useful for conditioning small-polar-aperture spherical reconstructions.
